\section*{Problem Sheet 1: Kinematics}

\begin{enumerate}

\item A particle of mass $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ follows the path $\vec{r}(t) = 15 t
  \hat{\jmath} - 5 t^2 \hat{k}$. Find the force acting on it at time $t$.

\item Two ships sail from the same point. Are they on a crash course? If not,
  find their distance of closest approach.

\end{enumerate}
